text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Still... those gals' vibe is totally 
different from mine. 
Buena gets along fine with people like 
that, though... How do you do it?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...? I wonder... Personally, I don't 
feel like I'm doing anything special..."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously? What should I do, then... If 
I'm struggling and Buena's pulling it off 
without even thinking about it, that 
means—"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I can just imitate Buena as she is? 
...No use overthinking it. Be like Buena, 
be like Buena!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, yo. 
...I mean, nope! Hey there, e-everyone!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Uh... I-I'd kinda like to spill my 
guts... er, have a h-heart-to-heart... 
with you guys..."

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Umm... so... 
Are you trying to get... ripped abs...?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: THAT'S NOT WHAT I MEAAAAANT!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"D-Don't give up, Espo-san! 
I'm sure it'll go better next time. Let me 
think of something too...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm... If it's hard for you to take a 
gentler approach, Espo-san, maybe we 
should use a buffer?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"I can play an in-between character to 
bridge the gap, so neither you nor they 
will feel awkward talking!"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...An in-between character?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"'Sup, folks. H-How's it hangin'? 
Umm, you know, how are things?"

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"What's with the shades, Buena-chan? 
That's ultra-cute~! 
We totally gotta share this with 
everyone♪"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Huh? Ah, no, that's not it... 
I-If you'd like, how 'bout we go 'hit up a 
joint' after this—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"W-Would you like to hit up your... 
'homies'?... and ch-chat over some 
limited-edition berry tarts?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"That was way too forced! They were just 
doting on you!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh... I based it on something I saw in a 
TV drama before, but... 
Maybe instead of how we speak, we should 
approach them with a common interest?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Nah~, it's not like an arranged marriage 
meeting. Starting with 'What are your 
hobbies~' makes breaking the ice pretty 
tough, doesn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa!? Tr-Tran...!? 
Wait, what do you mean, 'breaking the 
ice'—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"If you're having trouble, how about this? 
It's a custom rhythm game that's been 
trending lately."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? Sorry, but I really don't have 
time to be playing games right—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, if you're stuck anyway, it's a 
great excuse for a break. 
Plus, it lets me test my custom chart, so 
it's a win-win."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa...! This is surprisingly... 
hard...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So you play cooperatively to conquer a 
single song... 
You have to match your breathing and... 
ah--?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Tran-san. 
This might actually work.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty☆ Today, we have a special game 
that Tran-san prepared for us☆ 
Let's compete for the highest score by 
team♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Don't think of this as just an 
ordinary rhythm game. 
It's a hot piece of software that 
officially supports user mods!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
This custom PC version supports up to 
10-player co-op! 
Depending on the setup, it can get even 
more fun. Quite the masterpiece, if I do 
say so myself♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The secret to getting a high score is 
staying in sync with everyone☆ 
So let's jump right in and give it a shot, 
everyone♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Buena-chan, it's our duet section now! 
Stay in sync with me♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, here comes that crazy-hard duet 
section again! 
We totally bombed this part earlier... 
What do we do?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(...If only we could play like Buena and 
the others... 
Dammit, this is so frustrating...!)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Ora! Ora! Oraaa!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Ora! Ora! Ora-raaa! 
Ora-ora! Raaa!

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Ora, ora, oraaa, ora, ora, oraraaa. 
Ora-ora, raaa... Ah... I-I actually did 
it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh... That seriously worked...! Nice 
going, Espo-chan! 
Your "Ora-Ora method" saved us! Thanks a 
ton!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Pfft, what kind of name is that?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ 
Congrats on clearing it☆

text_block_list.name: Timid-Looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... W-We cleared it just by 
"ora-ora-ing" together...! 
Espo-san... Th-Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
S-Stop shouting "ora-ora" every single 
time! 
...Man, you sure go from freaking out to 
thrilled in a heartbeat... Sheesh.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, doesn't the riff in this song 
feel kinda similar to ours? 
Like, right around here—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wow... The whole atmosphere of the trumpet 
section 
has completely changed...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-fufu. Games can transcend language 
barriers, y'know? 
Especially an intuitive rhythm game like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Even if you can't talk it out, as long as 
you can laugh to the same beat, there's no 
problem. 
The finer communication will follow right 
along later♪
